<details><summary><code>client.auth.<a href="src/fern/auth/client.py">refresh</a>() -> AuthenticationResource</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Authenticated, unlike invitation redemption: the credential being renewed is the one the
request carries, so a client whose token has already expired signs in again rather than
refreshing.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.auth.refresh()

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request_options:** `typing.Optional[RequestOptions]` — Request-specific configuration.
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

## Organizationlogo
<details><summary><code>client.organizationlogo.<a href="src/fern/organizationlogo/client.py">show</a>(...)</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Behind the bearer token like everything else here, because which organizations exist is not
public. A browser cannot put a token on an `<img src>`, so a client fetches this and hands
the response to the element as an object URL.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```python
from fern import FernApi
from fern.environment import FernApiEnvironment

client = FernApi(
    environment=FernApiEnvironment.DEFAULT,
)

client.organizationlogo.show(
    organization="organization",
)

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**organization:** `str` — The organization ID
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**request_options:** `typing.Optional[RequestOptions]` — Request-specific configuration.
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>
